claims.title: Complete classical-channel SLD order has a finite signed-variance certificate

scoped_dependencies.relation: Related family context: the candidate establishes a common-lift necessity statement only for classical channels; it does not establish the unrestricted noncommutative quantum-channel converse. The full-span perturbation obstruction blocks one proposed continuity route.
Complete-information-order family context only; no logical dependence and no validation or strengthening of the N675 hardness claim.

interface: Finite row-stochastic classical channels; all finite untouched quantum references are allowed.
certificate: M J = N; J 1_n = 1_m; diag(N_{x,:}) - J^T diag(M_{x,:}) J is positive semidefinite for each input x.
limits: General finite characterization is a polynomial-size SDP, not a claimed polynomial-time exact algorithm at singular boundaries.
The full-span perturbation counterexample blocks a continuity route, not the general quantum common-lift conjecture.
